newsitem.title: UK: HTV close to sealing Warner Bros deal-paper.
newsitem.headline: HTV close to sealing Warner Bros deal-paper.

text.p: HTV Group Plc, the UK independent television company for Wales and the west of England, is near to clinching a production alliance with Warner Brothers of the U.S., said the Financial Times on Friday.
Warner is keen to expand its interests in Europe and has chosen HTV as a preferred partner, said the report.
The deal is expected to be worth millions of stg and involves at least three series. One series is a 26-part half-hour animated series on Zorro -- the masked swordsman from Spanish Califonia.
Another series is an action adventure series set in England, said the report.
